name: 12020 · Ballston Spa, NY
findings: ZIP 12020 (Ballston Spa) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12020 (Ballston Spa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
